answer: Plume-River Ceremony Bond. A plume from the beacon opens a 15-minute window: every identity files a fresh signed proof into the river ledger. No operator runs 1,000 ceremonies: each proof needs a distinct live reading, and a late, copied, or rented proof burns the 70 bond. A hollow identity, an empty shell, pays 110 for a proof it cannot make, so 1,000 hollow identities pay 110,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
